# Motion Proposal:
## Motion Text:

This motion proposal seeks approval to proceed with the development of DIGGY’s second game. Once approved, a follow-up fund transfer proposal will be submitted for $5,000 USD in ICP, to be split in two phases: 50% upon approval of the transfer proposal, and the remaining 50% upon delivery of the completed game. This initiative reinforces DIGGY’s long-term vision of adoption and visibility as a memecoin within the ICP ecosystem through engaging, burn-based gameplay experiences.
summary:
## General Overview This proposal seeks community approval to move forward with the development of DIGGY’s second game, in alignment with the roadmap approved in [Motion Proposal #360](https://nns.ic0.app/proposal/?u=xjngq-yaaaa-aaaaq-aabha-cai&proposal=360). The goal is to continue expanding the reach and utility of the token through interactive experiences that promote burning and active community participation. ## Development of Game #2 **Comprehensive Development Process:** - The second DIGGY game will be conceptualized, illustrated, developed, and published on the Boom DAO platform. **Optimization:** - Insights from the [first game](https://6v7kz-xaaaa-aaaal-ar7ea-cai.raw.icp0.io/) will be applied to improve both the burn mechanic efficiency and overall user experience. **Ecosystem Impact:** - This new game will expand the token’s use case, sustaining interaction through a play-to-burn dynamic. --- ## Execution After Approval Once this motion proposal is approved, a funds transfer proposal will be submitted, divided into two parts: - 50% of the total requested ($2,500 USD in ICP): To be transferred upon approval of the fund transfer proposal. - Remaining 50% ($2,500 USD in ICP): To be requested upon delivery of the second game. - ## Conclusion Approving this proposal will allow continued progress in the $DIGGY roadmap and sustain momentum through game releases that boost token visibility, adoption, and sustainability within the ICP ecosystem. --------------------------------

This proposal was created using [https://ic-toolkit.app](https://ic-toolkit.app)
